title: How Much Does it Cost to build a Doctor Consultation app?
creator: aroofshaikh@gmail.com
content:
Cost to build a Develop Doctor Consultation app

With time, the demand for tech-based Medical solutions will only grow. However, as time passes and pandemic breakouts become more common, it may become increasingly difficult for patients to get out and see their doctors' clinics for routine consultations. Doctor appointment apps, online medicine delivery apps, and other doctor-on-demand app solutions exploded in popularity as a result of this awareness.

The same solution has encouraged doctors in expanding their services and reaching more patients, from physical clinics to virtually serving anyone with a mobile phone, internet access, and a disease that needs to be cured. 

With features such as video calling, chatting, sending and receiving documents, and tracking symptoms, on-demand doctor consultation apps will only widespread in the coming years.

Healthcare costs are spiraling out of control, acting as a new trend to dupe people in society. To offset rising costs, doctor-on-demand and telemedicine app development have emerged as a fortune for managing chronic conditions, which have emerged as a fast-growing and potentially disruptive segment in the healthcare industry.

If you are in the mindset of making an entry into the tech health development world, then being knowledgeable about the cost to develop a doctor consultation app or telemedicine app turns out to be wise.

For that, you need to stay in tune with the interesting blog structured by a top telemedicine app Development Company 

Well, the On-demand doctor appointment apps or telemedicine apps have become the leading reason for the revolution in the healthcare industry. When we talk of Building such apps, it doesn’t turn out to be an easy task, as comes with a lot of features, tech stack, and advancement 

.However, the most important features that serve as the app's foundation and even decide the cost of the building medical apps criteria are listed below.

Features of Telemedicine/ On-demand doctor consultation apps 

The Doctor-on-Demand app is a combination of two separate apps:

Patient App Features 

Sign Up

Patients can register using their email address or mobile phone number. We recommend using two-factor authentication, which includes SMS/voice/phone verification because the app deals with sensitive data.

User profile

Users can build a profile and enter information such as their profile picture, name, age, sex, address, city, medical ailments, and more.

Search Doctors

Doctors can be found and explored using filters such as specialization, degrees, ratings, location, and so on.

View Doctor’s profile

After selecting a Doctor, the user should be able to view the doctor's profile, which should include information such as a photo, specialization, address, consultation fees, email, phone, and available appointment slots.

Schedule Appointments

Patients can use the calendar to check the doctor's availability and book an appointment with the doctor by selecting the communication mode (phone call, via chat, video calling, or in-person). The appointment can be rescheduled or canceled.

Booking Specifics

Allow patients to book appointments for themselves as well as dependent profiles such as family members or friends.

Appointment Type

 Allow patients to choose an appointment type, such as on-demand or scheduled.

Select Payment Mode

Patients should be able to choose their payment method as well as their insurance and health plan (if any).

Payments

Patients can make secure online payments using a variety of payment gateway integrations such as cards, wallets, net banking, and so on.

Video Calling Within the App

Integrated audio and video calling for real-time patient-doctor interaction.

Chat/ Messaging 

The ability to communicate with doctors via chat or text message.

Medical Records in Electronic Form

Patients can provide doctors with medical reports and other health-related data for diagnosis and treatment.

Ratings and Reviews

Patients can rate, review, and provide feedback to doctors.

Favorites marked

Mark favorite doctors to make it easier to find and contact them at a glance.

Notifications

Notifications (email, SMS, push) to remind patients of upcoming appointments, medications, and payments, among other things.

Doctor App Features

Profile Doctor

Doctors can create detailed profiles, add clinics they serve with locations, and list their availability times, among other things.

Make an Appointment

Doctors can make appointments for their patients based on their availability.

Accept or decline an appointment

In non-emergency situations, a doctor may refuse to see a patient by selecting the reject option or accepting when it is available.

Set Availability 

Doctors can set their availability status to online or offline, as well as control on-demand availability toggles such as whether they are available for a phone call, video call, or home visit.

ePrescription

This feature enables doctors to send online prescriptions to patients, which are then saved in one of two databases.

Video Call in Real-Time

Doctors can use video conferencing to add other medical specialists to live video calls with patients.

White Boards

This feature is entirely optional. Whiteboards can be used by doctors to explain anything to patients or other doctors.

Store and Forward

Medical data, images, and patient histories can be securely stored and shared by doctors.

EMR Integration

Doctors can integrate patient histories and records with EMRs to conduct seamless remote visits.

Multi-Channel Video Solution

This feature can be kept as an add-on in which doctors can video conference with their peers or other specialists.

The Admin Panel Features 

Patient Management 

Admin has access to all of a patient's information, including their medical history.

Doctors Management

Admin can manage and view information about doctors, and their areas of specialization, and categorize them.

Specialty Management

The administrator can manage specialties, and appointment fees, check their status, and take action by editing, making them active, or inactive.

Reports Management

Admin has complete access to all patient-related reports. Admin can view the number of appointments booked, the number of ongoing appointments, canceled appointments, and so on.

Site statistics

Admin can view the total number of patients, providers, clinics, and earnings.

Statistics on Appointments

Total appointments, active appointments, canceled appointments, and completed appointments can all be viewed by the admin.

Technology Stack to be used in Doctor On Demand App

Programming languages: Kotlin, Java (Android), Swift (iOS)

Insurance verification: PokitDok

ePrescription : EazyScript

Video Conferencing: WebRTC

Chat: Twilio, Socket.io

Database: MySQL

APIs and frameworks: Stripe, EC2, S3

The total cost of developing a doctor-on-demand app is determined by the following services provided by a telemedicine app development company:

iOS and Android native app development UI/UX design

Development of the backend

Website creation

Project administration

Quality control.

According to our estimates and experience in developing comprehensive telemedicine apps with customized features, the costs are heavily influenced by the hourly rates charged by the healthcare app development company, which range from $25/hr to $50/hr.

As previously discussed, the cost of developing an on-demand doctor app can vary due to a variety of factors as well as specific restrictions imposed by a developer. The platform, whether Android or iOS, determines whether the app is expensive or inexpensive to develop.

The iOS platform is more likely to be expensive than the Android platform. Furthermore, the location or geography of the company that creates the app is critical. The estimated cost of developing an on-demand doctor app or telemedicine app from the ReapMind team ranges between $5000 to $100,000.
